external_requirements: The bundled linear fixture does not validate fidelity for any physical system; production twins require domain models and representative observations.
input_contract: System identity, model family, calibration observations, validation observations, scenarios, and decision contract.
output_contract: Calibrated model identity, simulations, residual and sensitivity evidence, applicability bounds, and reviewed recommendation.
problem: Calibrate a model, simulate scenarios, validate on untouched observations, quantify sensitivity, and bound applicability.
title: Observed system to a validated simulation and decision dossier
